question.knowledge_point: Determining the Image of an Object Formed by a Singular Transformation
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13993138/assets/6501b1a7e9429c786905c11835410111c32ac0337f1ba63bff130d327350316c.png)

Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Which of the following is the image of the triangle shown above under the action of $T?$
question.worked_solution:
To find the image of the triangle under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of the triangle:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6 & 8 & 10 \\ 3 & 4 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the image's vertices are $(6,3)$, $(8,4)$ and $(10,5).$ Notice that all three points lie on the same line.
